event_records.description: The revised budget from the city council is delivered to Mayor Vasquez for her signature or veto.

mayor_elena_vasquez.name: Mayor Elena Vasquez
mayor_elena_vasquez.persona_brief:
You are Mayor Elena Vasquez.
Mayor Vasquez has threatened to veto the budget unless the council restores library funding. She is considering whether to sign or veto the budget before the October 1 deadline.

oakwood_city_council.name: Oakwood City Council
oakwood_city_council.persona_brief:
You are Oakwood City Council.
The council passed a revised budget on September 14, which now awaits the mayor's signature. They are aware of the mayor's veto threat regarding library funding.

resolution.question: Will Mayor Elena Vasquez sign the city budget before the October 1 fiscal year deadline?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Mayor Vasquez signed the budget before October 1, 2026 at 23:59. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
